issue_context.body:
##### SUMMARY

##### ISSUE TYPE

##### COMPONENT NAME

##### ANSIBLE VERSION

##### STEPS TO REPRODUCE

Previous version of ansible (v2.8.6) provided the following example output when the terraform plan was run:
```
TASK [planTerraform : Display all terraform output for VPC] ********************
ok: [127.0.0.1] => {
    "vpc_tf_stack.stdout_lines": [
        "Acquiring state lock. This may take a few moments...", 
        "Refreshing Terraform state in-memory prior to plan...",
        "The refreshed state will be used to calculate this plan, but will not be",
        "persisted to local or remote state storage.",
        "", 
        "aws_vpc.myVPC: Refreshing state... [id=vpc-12312312312312312]",
        "aws_s3_bucket.myBucketVPCFlowLogs: Refreshing state... [id=s3-something-something-something]",
        "aws_route53_zone.myAdminHostedZone: Refreshing state... [id=Z12312312312312312312]",
        "aws_internet_gateway.myInternetGateway: Refreshing state... [id=igw-12312312312312312]",
        "aws_security_group.myExternalSecurityGroup: Refreshing state... [id=sg-12312312312312312]",
        "aws_route53_zone.myLocalHostedZone: Refreshing state... [id=Z23423423423423423423]",
        "aws_route_table.myPublicRouteTable: Refreshing state... [id=rtb-12312312312312312]",
        "aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block.myBucketVPCFlowLogsPubAccessBlock: Refreshing state... [id=s3-blah-blah-blah-blah-blah-blah]",
        "aws_flow_log.myVPCFlowLogs: Refreshing state... [id=fl-12312312312312312]",
        "", 
        "------------------------------------------------------------------------",
        "", 
        "No changes. Infrastructure is up-to-date.",
        "", 
        "This means that Terraform did not detect any differences between your",
        "configuration and real physical resources that exist. As a result, no",
        "actions need to be performed.",
        "Releasing state lock. This may take a few moments..."
    ]

```

The problem appears to be [line 362 in terraform.py](https://github.com/ansible/ansible/blob/devel/lib/ansible/modules/cloud/misc/terraform.py#L362).

Removing:
```
out, err = '', ''
```
and recompiling the terraform module appears to bring output back to stdout.

Hi @Akasurde (and @mattclay),

Apologies if this is not the proper way of requesting help, but from my looking around the code, it appears that  https://github.com/ansible/ansible/pull/57044 has supressed stdout from terraform. Am I missing something in the way I am running things?

Hi @ryansb - just wondering about the process in this repo around who maintains / looks at terraform.py? Are you able to advise?

Apologies to have written to you (if that is not the normal process), but I saw you being the initial committer for this module.

@ric-man sadly the terraform module does not have an active maintaner. `out, err = '', ''` is of course the cause. If you provide a pull request I can review and test, after that we can trigger a core maintaner to merge.

Hi @dano0b - happy to raise a PR, but not sure the correct procedure with this repository. Do I create my own branch, and then PR it to devel, or do I make the change directly to devel, and PR it to stable-2.9?
Thanks for the assistance @dano0b. PR has been made.

review_comments:
I don't think simply removing this line is the correct means to fix both #64369 and maintain the fix for https://github.com/ansible/ansible/issues/56934

It looks like instead, this line needs to be moved to above line 350.  Otherwise, you may still get the error in #56934

I think the fix from https://github.com/ansible/ansible/pull/57044 missed that `out` and `err` could be set on line 358.
Hi @sivel - I have moved the line as suggested. Thanks for being patient with me.
